title: Every Company Is a Fintech Company

reader_summary.headline: why every company will become a fintech company, the next era of financial services.
reader_summary.overview: why every company will become a fintech company, the next era of financial services, and the AWS phase for fintech by Angela Strange. You can also find and share this essay at a6.c.com slash fintech everywhere. There are two banking systems in the world today.

key_points.text: One for people with money or good credit, and another for people without.
